t: am / is / are — «bo'lmoq» fe'li
d: O'zbekchada «Men talabaman» deymiz va «bo'lmoq» fe'li ko'rinmaydi. Inglizchada u albatta yoziladi: I bilan am, he/she/it bilan is, you/we/they bilan are.
f: I am · he / she / it is · you / we / they are
q: Savolda are gap boshiga chiqadi: Are you…?

t: a / an / the
d: Bitta, hali noma'lum narsa haqida gapirganda a qo'yiladi, unli tovush oldidan esa an (an apple, an hour). Ikkalamizga ma'lum, aniq narsa oldidan the keladi. O'zbekchada bunday so'z yo'q, shuning uchun ko'pincha unutiladi.
f: a + undosh (a book) · an + unli (an egg) · the + aniq narsa
ex: She eats an apple every day.
U har kuni bitta olma yeydi.
q: umbrella unli tovush bilan boshlanadi: an.
hour so'zida h o'qilmaydi, u unli tovush bilan boshlanadi: an.

t: Ko'plik -s va this / these / that / those
d: Ko'plikda otga -s qo'shiladi: book → books. Sondan keyin ham -s qoladi: two books. Ayrim so'zlar boshqacha o'zgaradi: man → men, child → children. Yaqindagi narsa: this (bitta), these (ko'p). Uzoqdagi narsa: that (bitta), those (ko'p).
f: this / that + bitta · these / those + ko'p
q: There are five ___ in the room.

t: Hozirgi oddiy zamon: odat va doimiy ishlar
d: Har kuni, doim, odatda bo'ladigan ish uchun fe'lning oddiy shakli ishlatiladi: I work, we live. Gap tartibi: kim + fe'l + nima/qayerda. Fe'l egadan keyin darhol keladi, o'zbekchadagidek gap oxirida emas.
f: I / you / we / they + fe'l (work, live, like)
ex: Men har kuni ertalab choy ichaman.
q: we bilan fe'lning oddiy shakli: live.

t: he / she / it + fe'l + s
d: Hozirgi oddiy zamonda he, she, it (yoki bitta odam, bitta narsa) bilan fe'lga -s qo'shiladi: she works. -sh, -ch, -o, -x bilan tugasa -es: he watches, she goes. Undosh + y bo'lsa -ies: study → studies. have esa has bo'ladi.
f: he / she / it + fe'l + s (works, goes, has)
ex: My brother watches TV every evening.
Akam har kuni kechqurun televizor ko'radi.

t: Inkor va savol: don’t / doesn’t, Do / Does
d: Inkor gapda fe'ldan oldin don’t, he/she/it bilan doesn’t qo'yiladi va fe'lga -s qo'shilmaydi: She doesn’t work. Savolda Do yoki Does gap boshiga chiqadi: Do you like tea? Does he speak English?
f: I don’t + fe'l · he doesn’t + fe'l · Do you…? · Does she…?

t: Egalik: my, your, his, her … va 's
d: O'zbekchadagi -im, -ing, -i qo'shimchalari o'rniga otdan oldin alohida so'z qo'yiladi: my book — kitobim. Odamga tegishli narsa uchun 's ishlatiladi: Ali’s phone — Alining telefoni.
f: my · your · his · her · its · our · their · Ali’s + ot
ex: Our flat is on the fifth floor.

t: There is / There are — «… bor»
d: Biror joyda nimadir borligini aytish uchun There is (bitta) va There are (ko'p) ishlatiladi. O'zbekchadagi «… bor» shu. Savol: Is there…? Are there…? Inkor: There isn’t / There aren’t.
f: There is + bitta · There are + ko'p · Is there…?
ex: There is a bank near my house.
There are many trees in the park.
q: There ___ a book on the table.
There ___ three rooms in our flat.
___ there a bus to the airport?
There ___ any milk in the fridge.

t: can / can’t — «qila olmoq»
d: can — «qila olmoq». Undan keyin fe'l o'zgarmaydi va to qo'yilmaydi: I can swim. Inkor: can’t (cannot). Savol: Can you…? Iltimos qilishda ham ishlatiladi: Can I sit here?
f: ega + can / can’t + fe'l · Can you…?
ex: I can speak a little English.
q: can dan keyin fe'lning oddiy shakli.
My little brother can ___ to ten.

t: Joy predloglari: in, on, under, next to, between
d: O'zbekchadagi -da, ustida, ostida kabi so'zlar inglizchada otdan oldin alohida so'z bo'lib keladi: in — ichida, on — ustida, under — ostida, next to — yonida, between — o'rtasida, in front of — oldida, behind — orqasida.
f: in · on · under · next to · between · in front of · behind
ex: The cat is under the bed.
The bank is next to the school.
My car is behind the house.
q: The shop is ___ the bank and the cafe.
The dog is sleeping ___ the table.

t: Hozirgi davomli zamon: hozir bo'layotgan ish
d: Ayni paytda bo'layotgan ish uchun am/is/are + fe'l + ing ishlatiladi: I am reading — Men o'qiyapman. Ko'pincha now, at the moment, Look! so'zlari bilan keladi.
f: am / is / are + fe'l-ing
q: They are ___ football at the moment.

t: Odat yoki hozir? work va am working
d: Odat, doimiy holat uchun hozirgi oddiy zamon (I work every day). Hozirning o'zida bo'layotgan ish uchun davomli zamon (I am working now). Ba'zi fe'llar davomli shaklda deyarli ishlatilmaydi: know, like, want, need, understand.
f: every day, usually → work · now, at the moment → am working
ex: He usually walks to work, but today he is taking a taxi.
U odatda ishga piyoda boradi, lekin bugun taksida ketyapti.
We are watching a film now.
q: I usually ___ tea in the morning.

t: was / were — «edi»
d: am/is ning o'tgan zamoni was, are niki were. I/he/she/it bilan was, you/we/they bilan were. Inkor: wasn’t, weren’t. Savol: Were you…?
f: I / he / she / it was · you / we / they were
ex: The weather was cold last week.
Were you at school on Monday?

t: O'tgan zamon: -ed
d: O'tgan zamonda ko'p fe'llarga -ed qo'shiladi: work → worked, play → played. -e bilan tugasa faqat -d: live → lived. Undosh + y bo'lsa -ied: study → studied. Fe'l barcha egalar uchun bir xil bo'ladi.
f: fe'l + ed (worked, lived, studied)
ex: I watched a film last night.
She lived in London for two years.
We visited our grandparents on Sunday.

t: Noto'g'ri fe'llar: go → went, see → saw
d: Ko'p ishlatiladigan fe'llarning o'tgan zamoni -ed bilan emas, boshqacha yasaladi. Ularni yodlash kerak: go → went, see → saw, eat → ate, buy → bought, take → took, make → made, come → came, give → gave.
f: go → went · see → saw · buy → bought · eat → ate
q: I ___ a strange dream last night.

t: O'tgan zamonda savol va inkor: did / didn’t
d: O'tgan zamonda savol va inkor uchun did ishlatiladi. Shunda fe'l oddiy shaklga qaytadi: I didn’t go (went emas). Savol: Did you see…? Qisqa javob: Yes, I did. / No, I didn’t.
f: didn’t + fe'l · Did + ega + fe'l…?
ex: I didn't sleep well last night.
q: We ___ go out because of the rain.

t: Kelajak: going to — reja
d: Oldindan rejalashtirilgan ish uchun am/is/are going to + fe'l ishlatiladi: I am going to visit my aunt. Ko'rinib turgan voqea uchun ham ishlatiladi: Look at the clouds! It is going to rain.
f: am / is / are going to + fe'l
ex: I am going to learn English this year.
They are going to buy a house.
Look at the sky! It is going to rain.
q: What ___ you going to do tomorrow?

t: Kelajak: will — qaror, va'da, bashorat
d: will kelajak uchun ishlatiladi: shu zahoti qabul qilingan qaror, va'da yoki bashorat. will dan keyin fe'l o'zgarmaydi: I will help you. Inkor: won’t (will not).
f: ega + will / won’t + fe'l
ex: Don't worry, I won't tell anyone.
I think it will be sunny tomorrow.
q: I'm cold. — I ___ close the window.
She will ___ you at the station.
I promise I ___ be late again.
___ you help me with this bag?

t: Qiyoslash: taller than, more expensive than
d: Ikki narsani solishtirishda qisqa sifatlarga -er + than qo'shiladi: tall → taller than. Uzun sifatlar oldidan more qo'yiladi: more expensive than. Maxsus shakllar: good → better, bad → worse.
f: sifat + er + than · more + uzun sifat + than
ex: My brother is taller than me.
This phone is more expensive than that one.
q: A car is ___ than a bike.
This book is ___ interesting than the film.
My English is ___ now than last year.

t: Eng …: the tallest, the most beautiful
d: Ko'p narsa ichida «eng …» ni aytish uchun the + sifat + est yoki the most + uzun sifat ishlatiladi: the tallest, the most beautiful. Maxsus shakllar: good → the best, bad → the worst.
f: the + sifat + est · the most + uzun sifat
ex: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
She is the best student in our class.
This is the most beautiful city I know.
Bu men bilgan eng chiroyli shahar.
q: He is the ___ boy in the class.
It was the ___ day of my life.
This is the ___ expensive hotel in the city.

t: much / many, some / any
d: Sanaladigan otlar (apple, book) bilan many, sanalmaydiganlar (water, money, time) bilan much ishlatiladi. a lot of ikkalasiga ham mos keladi. Darak gapda va taklifda some, inkor va savolda odatda any.
f: many + books · much + water · a lot of + ikkalasi · some / any
ex: How many brothers do you have?
q: There are ___ people in the street.

t: Present perfect: hayotdagi tajriba (ever, never)
d: have/has + fe'lning 3-shakli (V3) hayotda biror marta bo'lgan yoki bo'lmagan ishni aytadi, vaqti muhim emas: I have been to Moscow. Savol: Have you ever…? Inkor: I have never…
f: have / has + V3 (been, seen, eaten)
ex: I have never seen the sea.
q: I have ___ this film three times.

t: Present perfect yoki oddiy o'tgan zamon? just, already, yet
d: Aniq o'tgan vaqt aytilsa (yesterday, in 2019, last week) oddiy o'tgan zamon ishlatiladi: I saw him yesterday. Vaqt aytilmasa yoki natija hozir muhim bo'lsa, present perfect: I have lost my keys. just — hozirgina, already — allaqachon, yet — hali (inkor va savolda).
f: yesterday → saw · just / already / yet → have seen
ex: I have just finished my homework.
q: She has ___ left. You missed her.

t: Majburiyat va maslahat: must, have to, should
d: must — qat'iy majburiyat yoki qoida: You must stop. have to — tashqi sabab bilan majburiyat: I have to work on Saturday. should — maslahat: You should see a doctor. mustn’t — taqiq, don’t have to — shart emas.
f: must / have to + fe'l (majburiyat) · should + fe'l (maslahat)
ex: You must wear a seat belt.
I have to get up early tomorrow.
q: You look tired. You ___ go to bed.
Tomorrow is Sunday, so I ___ go to work.
She ___ wear a uniform at school.

t: Real shart: If it rains, we will stay
d: Bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan shart uchun: if + hozirgi zamon, natija qismida will. If it rains, we will stay at home. Diqqat: if dan keyin will qo'yilmaydi.
f: If + hozirgi zamon, … will + fe'l
ex: If you study hard, you will pass the exam.
If it rains, we will stay at home.
I will call you if I have time.
q: If you ___ now, you will catch the bus.
If it is sunny, we ___ to the park.
She will be angry if you ___ late.
If I see him, I ___ him.

t: O'tgan davomli zamon: was doing
d: was/were + fe'l-ing o'tmishdagi ma'lum paytda davom etayotgan ishni aytadi: At eight I was having dinner. Ko'pincha qisqa voqea bilan birga keladi: I was walking when it started to rain.
f: was / were + fe'l-ing … when + o'tgan zamon
ex: I was reading when the phone rang.
They were playing football at five.
Soat beshda ular futbol o'ynayotgan edi.
What were you doing last night?
q: She was cooking when the lights ___ out.

t: -ing yoki to + fe'l: enjoy doing, want to do
d: Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin -ing keladi: enjoy, finish, mind, avoid: I enjoy reading. Boshqalaridan keyin to + fe'l: want, decide, plan, hope, need: I want to travel. Predlogdan keyin doim -ing: interested in learning.
f: enjoy / finish / avoid + -ing · want / decide / hope + to + fe'l
ex: I enjoy swimming in the sea.
U chet elda o'qishga qaror qildi.

t: Majhul nisbat: is made, was built
d: Ishni kim qilgani emas, ishning o'zi muhim bo'lsa, majhul nisbat ishlatiladi: be + V3. Hozirgi: English is spoken here. O'tgan: The house was built in 1990. Bajaruvchini by bilan aytish mumkin.
f: am / is / are + V3 · was / were + V3 (+ by …)
ex: English is spoken all over the world.
This mosque was built five hundred years ago.
Bu masjid besh yuz yil oldin qurilgan.
The letters are delivered every morning.
q: The book was written ___ a famous author.

t: Aniqlovchi gaplar: who, which, that, where
d: Odam haqida qo'shimcha ma'lumot uchun who, narsa haqida which yoki that, joy haqida where ishlatiladi: The man who lives next door is a doctor. O'zbekchada bu «…gan / …digan» shakliga to'g'ri keladi: qo'shnida yashaydigan odam.
f: odam + who · narsa + which / that · joy + where
ex: The woman who works here is my aunt.
Bu yerda ishlaydigan ayol mening xolam.
This is the book which I told you about.
That's the restaurant where we met.
q: The boy ___ won the prize is my cousin.
I lost the bag ___ you gave me.
This is the town ___ I was born.
The film ___ we watched was boring.

t: used to — «oldin … edim»
d: used to + fe'l o'tmishda odat bo'lgan, hozir esa yo'q ishni aytadi: I used to play football — Oldin futbol o'ynardim. Inkor: didn’t use to. Savol: Did you use to…?
f: used to + fe'l · didn’t use to + fe'l
ex: I used to live in a village.
She used to have long hair.
We didn't use to have a car.
q: When I was a child, I ___ to swim in the river.
He used to ___ a lot, but now he doesn't.
Did you ___ to walk to school?
There ___ to be a cinema here.
There used to be — oldin bor edi.

t: Present perfect continuous: … dan beri
d: have/has been + fe'l-ing o'tmishda boshlanib, hozirgacha davom etayotgan ishni aytadi: I have been learning English for two years. for — davomida (two years), since — dan beri (2020).
f: have / has been + fe'l-ing · for + muddat · since + boshlangan payt
ex: I have been waiting for an hour.
She has been working here since 2018.
How long have you been studying English?
Qancha vaqtdan beri ingliz tilini o'rganyapsiz?
q: I have been living here ___ five years.
They have been playing ___ three o'clock.

t: Past perfect: had done — undan oldin
d: had + V3 o'tmishdagi ikki voqeadan qaysi biri oldinroq bo'lganini ko'rsatadi: When I arrived, the train had left — Men yetib kelganimda poyezd ketib bo'lgan edi.
f: had + V3 (oldinroq voqea) … o'tgan zamon (keyingi voqea)
ex: When we arrived, the film had already started.
Biz yetib kelganimizda film allaqachon boshlangan edi.
She had never flown before that trip.
U o'sha safargacha hech qachon samolyotda uchmagan edi.
I realised that I had forgotten my passport.
q: When I got home, my family ___ dinner.
He was tired because he ___ all day.
By the time the police came, the thief ___.
I ___ never seen snow before I moved to Moscow.

t: Xayoliy shart: If I had…, I would…
d: Hozir yoki kelajakda real bo'lmagan, xayoliy holat uchun: If + o'tgan zamon, natijada would + fe'l. If I had a million dollars, I would travel the world. to be bilan barcha egalarga were: If I were you…
f: If + o'tgan zamon, … would + fe'l
ex: If I had more time, I would learn Chinese.
Ko'proq vaqtim bo'lganida, xitoy tilini o'rganardim.
If I were you, I would accept the offer.
Sizning o'rningizda bo'lganimda, taklifni qabul qilardim.
What would you do if you won the lottery?
q: If I ___ rich, I would buy a big house.
If she studied more, she ___ the exam.
I would help you if I ___ how.
If I were you, I ___ that.

t: O'tmishdagi shart: If I had known…
d: O'tmishda bo'lmagan holat va uning natijasi, ko'pincha afsus: If + had + V3, natijada would have + V3. If I had known, I would have helped you — Bilganimda, yordam bergan bo'lardim.
f: If + had + V3, … would have + V3
ex: If you had told me, I would have come.
If we had left earlier, we wouldn't have missed the train.
She would have passed if she had studied harder.
Ko'proq o'qiganida, u imtihondan o'tgan bo'lardi.
q: If I had seen him, I ___ hello.
If they ___ the map, they wouldn't have got lost.
She would have come if you ___ her.
We ___ the match if we had played better.

t: O'zlashtirma gap: He said that…
d: Birovning gapini yetkazganda zamon odatda bir qadam orqaga suriladi: «I am tired» → She said that she was tired. will → would, can → could, am/is → was. Buyruq yetkazilganda: tell somebody to do: He told me to wait.
f: say / tell + (that) + zamon bir qadam orqaga
ex: He said that he was busy.
She told me to call her later.
U menga keyinroq qo'ng'iroq qilishimni aytdi.
q: «I am hungry.» → He said he ___ hungry.
«I will help.» → She said she ___ help.
«I can swim.» → He said he ___ swim.

t: Taxmin: must be, might be, can’t be
d: Taxmin qilishda: must — deyarli aniq ishonch (shunday bo'lsa kerak), might / may / could — balki, can’t — bo'lishi mumkin emas. He must be tired — U charchagan bo'lsa kerak.
f: must be (aniq) · might / may be (balki) · can’t be (mumkin emas)
ex: She must be at home; her car is outside.
U uyda bo'lsa kerak, mashinasi tashqarida turibdi.
q: He's been working all day. He ___ be tired.
I'm not sure. She ___ be at work.
That ___ be Ali. He is in London now.

t: Armon: I wish…
d: Hozirgi holatdan norozilik: I wish + o'tgan zamon: I wish I had a car — Qani endi mashinam bo'lsa. O'tmishdagi afsus: I wish + had + V3: I wish I had studied harder — Ko'proq o'qiganimda edi.
f: I wish + o'tgan zamon (hozir) · I wish + had + V3 (o'tmish)
ex: I wish I spoke English fluently.
I wish I had more free time.
Qani endi bo'sh vaqtim ko'proq bo'lsa.
She wishes she hadn't said that.
U buni aytmaganida edi, deb afsuslanadi.
q: I wish I ___ more money now.
I wish I ___ to the party yesterday.

t: Murakkab majhul nisbat: has been done, can be done
d: Majhul nisbat boshqa zamonlarda ham bor: present perfect — has/have been + V3 (The road has been repaired), modal fe'llar bilan — can/must/should be + V3 (This can be done today), kelajak — will be + V3.
f: has been + V3 · will be + V3 · can / must be + V3
ex: The bridge has been closed for repairs.
The results will be announced tomorrow.
This problem can be solved easily.
Bu muammoni osongina hal qilish mumkin.
q: A new school will be ___ next year.

t: Bog'lovchilar: although, despite, however, therefore
d: although + to'liq gap: Although it was cold, we went out. despite + ot yoki -ing: Despite the cold, we went out. however — biroq (yangi gap boshida, vergul bilan). therefore — shuning uchun (rasmiyroq).
f: although + gap · despite + ot / -ing · However, … · Therefore, …
ex: Although he was tired, he finished the work.
Charchagan bo'lsa ham, u ishni tugatdi.
Despite the rain, the match continued.
The test was hard. However, everyone passed.
Imtihon qiyin edi. Biroq hamma o'tdi.
q: ___ it was late, she kept working.
___ the traffic, we arrived on time.
It was expensive. ___, we bought it.
He was ill; ___, he stayed at home.

t: Birovga qildirmoq: have something done
d: Ishni o'zimiz emas, boshqa odam (usta, sartarosh) qilsa: have + narsa + V3. I had my hair cut — Sochimni oldirdim. I am going to have my car repaired — Mashinamni ta'mirlatmoqchiman.
f: have / get + narsa + V3
ex: I had my hair cut yesterday.
We are having our kitchen painted.
You should have your eyes tested.
q: I had my car ___ last week.
She is going to have her photo ___.
We ___ our house cleaned every month.
Where did you have your suit ___?
